title: BugsRequest
description: What the step before the last proof works from: the slice, its interface files, the test files the builder may not change, the bugs the owner named, and where the rounds stand after the last review.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the project.

fixed.description: The test files the slice's fails-first items name.

bugs.description: The bugs the owner named in the slice request; empty when there are none.

state.description: Where the rounds stand after the last review, as rounds.json gives it.
